name: filter-graphql
title: Filter GraphQL
description: Turns a filter-schema AST into a typed GraphQL `where` input for Hasura (`_and`, `_eq`, `_ilike`) or Prisma (`AND`, `equals`, `contains`), sent as variables, never spliced into the query.
docs: `graphqlWhere(toFilterAst(schema, values), { dialect, caseInsensitive })` returns an object for your query's variables; `{}` matches everything. `dialect` is `"hasura"` (default) or `"prisma"`, and `caseInsensitive` (default) uses Hasura `_ilike` or Prisma `mode: "insensitive"`. It takes `fields` and `dates` like every serializer. Pair it with `relaySource` from `page-source-relay` when the schema pages by connections.
